notes: The article on הַכֹּל goes unrepresented, the ASV writing *all* bare (rule 29).

רְעוּת רוּחַ splits under rule 19, the rectum taking the recast relation *after*; the indefinite article belongs to the construct noun that licenses it (rule 15). Margin readings 'a feeding on wind' and 'vexation of spirit' read and set aside (rule 38).
